result.summary: Design written to lib/letflow/design/gh2739-definitions-list-type-access.md. Denial is a correlated NOT EXISTS in the single list statement via a new shared TypeAccess.visible_to/2 built from the same denial base query as authorized?/3 and denied_types/3; keyset cursor (inserted_at,id) is a position so filtered pages, over-fetch row and next_cursor equal the world without X; crafted or old cursors are plain positions (no signal). list_definitions/2 replaced by /3 taking user_id (fail closed). No filters exist on the list, none added. No admin exemption (matches authorized?/3). Three single GETs verified to use render_get_definition/3 and stay untouched. 17 tests (T-17 all-denied added), 10 mutants. #2718 recommended as a separate PR. #2612 not triggered. Open questions Q1-Q6 with defaults in the design. AMENDED after CDV FAIL and SECURITY conditional PASS: visible_to/2 pinned, named binding :def with parent_as and WHERE placement, cross-module deps, deterministic next_cursor comparison rules, new shared QueryCount helper, T-12 blocking both directions, R2 single denial query, R3 solution-pack export recorded as open, decode_list_definitions_seek follow-up recorded. ROUND-2 CDV wording fixes applied (determinism rule on T-5/T-7/T-8/T-11/section 9, helper name in section 8).
